notes.title: Added 3DFX support files for BC3K 2.0
notes.notes:
[b]USE AT YOUR OWN RISK - COMPLETELY UNTESTED[/b]

The 3DFX support files are for use with [url=https://dosbox-staging.github.io/]DOSBox Staging[/url]. 

Run the [b]install_extras.exe[/b] file located in the game's install folder. This will install the .\EXTRAS folder containing the DOS games.

See [b].\Extras\README_EXTRAS.PDF[/b] for additional info. Info on running the 3DFX build is located in the [b]RUNNING BC3K/BC3K20 IN DOSBOX[/b] section.

Supported 3DFX drivers are located in the [b].\Extras\BC3K20\DRIVERS\[/b] folder which contains a [b]README.TXT[/b] file with additional info about the drivers.

Use [b]BC3K3DFX.BAT[/b] to run the 3DFX version.

[Supported 3DFX Cards]

[list]
[*]Voodoo
[*]Voodoo2
[*]Voodoo3
[*]Voodoo5
[*]Voodoo Banshee
[*]Voodoo Rush
[/list]

notes.title: Battlecruiser Generations Live!
notes.notes:
It took some doing, but I finally completed it. This is [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/345580/discussions/0/3038228835136251011/?ctp=3]how it all started[/url].

While I wasn't entirely certain that the DOS games would even work, advances in DOXbox technology worked wonders. And so, both (Battlecruiser 3000AD - 1996 & Battlecruiser 3000AD v2 - 1998) DOS games work flawlessly. 

Surprisingly - because of Windows, legacy DirectX and all that, I spent a lot more time getting both WIN games, Battlecruiser Millennium - 2001 & Battlecruiser Millennium Gold - 2003, to work in WIN10. Go figure. 

In the end, and as always, I had a faithful group of Battlecruiser fans who helped test as I released build after build - which failed Steam review twice in 48 hours. heh. ːsteammockingː

And so, a whole [url=http://www.3000ad.com/games/]generation of Battlecruiser[/url] titles is now on Steam to add to your space combat collection. Now you get to experience what all the fuss was about back in the day, and to play my very first game that got me here today.

The store page is live and you can now wishlist it. The release date is Sept 21st, a few weeks ahead of the original game's 25 year anniversary release in Oct 1996.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1755420/Battlecruiser_Generations/

Enjoy!

- DS
Supreme Commander
GALCOM
